briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: A federal investigation has begun into at least 10 missing or dead scientists across the US. Reports have surfaced from multiple states, indicating a widespread probe. The investigation appears to be focused on uncovering the circumstances surrounding the disappearance or death of these scientists, potentially involving research misconduct, foul play, or other malicious activities. As the investigation unfolds, it is essential to track connections between entities involved, follow the money, and examine potential patterns. The North Star Watchdog will continue to monitor this situation and provide updates as more information becomes available.
